name: Book of Golden Sands

features.name: Book wild/scatter
features.description: The book substitutes and triggers free spins.

features.name: Growing expansions
features.description: Each expansion of the special symbol adds an extra instance to its reel, increasing ways paid.

review:
A book slot rebuilt on a 6x3 grid with 729 ways, with multiplier wilds. The book is wild and scatter.

In free spins, a random symbol is picked, and when it expands over a reel it also adds an extra copy of itself on top – and each further expansion on that reel increases how many ways it pays. That stacking is how it reaches 10,000x, double a classic book slot's cap. 96.46% RTP. More dynamic than the usual book game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
